context: Scenario: USER_ORDER_FOOD_SUCCESS_1 — User opens app → selects restaurant → views menu (GET /restaurants/:id/menu) → picks items → places order (POST /orders) → pays via Stripe → gets confirmation (GET /orders/:id). Domain: food delivery. Payment via external Stripe gateway (outbound — needs stub, not api-test).

evals.title: Functional design tree structure
evals.prompt: Given scenario USER_ORDER_FOOD_SUCCESS_1 with 2 inbound API calls (GET /restaurants/:id/menu and POST /orders), build the functional design tree.
expectations: Tree has exactly 2 root nodes — one per inbound API endpoint in the scenario
Each root node is component level (it orchestrates children)
Every leaf function that directly hits DB or external gateway is integration — never unit
Every leaf function that does pure logic with no I/O is unit — never integration
No function is assigned more than one test level
Tree is ordered bottom-up — leaf nodes appear before their parent

evals.title: env-setup is always first and self-contained
evals.prompt: Generate the task list for USER_ORDER_FOOD_SUCCESS_1. What does 00-env-setup look like?
expectations: 00-env-setup is the very first task in 01-Setup/
It seeds scenario-specific data with concrete values from Datatest.md — not placeholder names
It includes a stub for the external payment gateway (Stripe is outbound)
It does NOT reference or depend on data from another scenario
Every other task across all folders has 00-env-setup in its depends_on

evals.title: Setup tasks are one-per-unit
evals.prompt: The scenario needs interfaces for the order request, order response, and menu response. Also needs an error code for payment failure. Generate Setup tasks.
expectations: Each interface is its own separate task — not bundled with other interfaces
The error code is its own separate task — not bundled with interfaces
Total Setup tasks (excluding env-setup) equals the number of distinct interfaces + distinct error codes
Each interface task's contract carries the full field-level shape — not just the type name
Each error code task references the error-codes.md registry entry

evals.title: Backlog TDD pairing — test before code, node by node
evals.prompt: Generate Backlog tasks for the menu retrieval branch of the functional design tree (the GET /restaurants/:id/menu side).
expectations: For each node in the branch: its test task(s) appear immediately before its code task — not separated by other nodes' tasks
Each code task's depends_on references only its own test task(s) — not tests from other nodes
Leaf nodes (repositories, pure logic) are done before their parent (controller/orchestrator)
WRONG pattern: all test tasks for every node grouped first, then all code tasks grouped after
The topmost node's code task depends_on its own test(s) and may also depend_on child code tasks

evals.title: Alternative/error cases are separate tasks with own NN
evals.prompt: The menu retrieval function has 3 cases: (1) success — returns available items, (2) restaurant not found — returns 404, (3) restaurant exists but menu is empty — returns empty array. Generate the test tasks.
expectations: 3 separate test tasks — one per case
Each has its own unique sequential NN number — no letter suffixes (a, b, c)
The code task depends_on all 3 test task ids
All 3 tests stay in 02-Backlog/ of this scenario — no new scenario created for the error cases
Each task's cases.given and cases.assert use values that distinguish the case (e.g. different IDs for found vs not-found)

evals.title: Api-test chain ordering and run command
evals.prompt: E2E flow: step 1 GET /restaurants/:id/menu → step 2 POST /orders → step 3 GET /orders/:id. Generate Api-test tasks.
expectations: Exactly 3 api-test tasks in 03-Api-test/, one per request in E2E order
depends_on forms a sequential chain: task 2 depends_on task 1, task 3 depends_on task 2
Only the LAST api-test task has the run command populated — the others have no command
Each task's contract references the request/response shape from gateway-contract.md — not invented

evals.title: Task self-sufficiency — carried content not just names
evals.prompt: Show the full task JSON for an integration test that queries the DB for menu items by restaurant ID.
expectations: contract carries the full function signature AND the shapes of any referenced types — not just type names (e.g. if return type is an array of items, the item shape's fields are spelled out)
cases has at least one given/assert with concrete values from Datatest.md — not 'some restaurant ID'
pseudocode has arrange → act → assert steps with no open design decisions left
targets has a concrete file path following testing-guide conventions — not a generic path
assume states what env-setup has already seeded — specific enough that the agent knows what data exists
acceptance states the test is expected to be red (function not yet implemented)

evals.title: Cross-check catches missing endpoint
evals.prompt: The E2E flow needs GET /restaurants/:id/menu, POST /orders, and GET /orders/:id. But gateway-directory.md Inbound only lists POST /orders and GET /orders/:id. Generate Api-test tasks.
expectations: Detects that one endpoint in the E2E flow is missing from gateway-directory.md Inbound
Does NOT silently create an api-test task for the unregistered endpoint
Does NOT invent the endpoint registration itself
Presents the 3 possibilities from the skill spec: incomplete functional design / unregistered line / outbound gateway
Asks the user to resolve before continuing
Adds the finding to self-report
